notes.title: Update 1.1 includes support for more resolutions!
notes.content:
Build v1.1 includes support for the following new display resolutions:

1366 x 768
1280 x 720

And, as always, it has support for 1920 x 1080

Even if your monitor isn't natively one of these resolutions, chances are good that your monitor can handle at least one of them.

The program automatically checks for the highest resolution first and works downward to give you the best resolution possible.

If you have any issues, let me know!

Have fun!
Matthew
